info.desc: Lonerism is the second album by Australian psychedelic rock band Tame Impala, released by Modular Recordings on 5 October 2012. Like their previous album Innerspeaker, most of the recording was undertaken by Kevin Parker. Kevin Parker started writing and recording new material for Lonerism almost immediately after releasing Innerspeaker, saying "I started writing songs straight after Innerspeaker, but I told myself I wouldn't get hung up with the pressure, so I kinda pretended they were for some other weird project that wasn't going to have as much consequence". podcast.body: Tame Impala is a vehicle for Kevin Parker, from Perth on the west coast of Australia. His 2012 album Lonerism produced international alt-rock hits including "Elephant," which exemplifies modern psychedelia: layers of processed guitars, driving rhythm, lysergic studio production. Parker writes, records, and produces virtually everything himself. "Modern psych from Australia's Tayman Palau."

podcast.body: This album, completely recorded in Kevin Parker's home studio, was Tame Impala's breakthrough record. It led to a nomination for Best Alternative Album at the 2012 Grammy Awards, establishing Tame Impala as one of the most successful new psych artists of the 2010s resurgence. "It was called Lonerism." "And this single helped the record get nominated for Best Alternative Album at the 2012 Grammy Awards."
